notes:
CHK-014 tracker is not given, so I rebuilt it from the interface signals. The owner=RD state is rd_busy. It is set on an AR handshake (arvalid && arready) while idle, and cleared on the R handshake with rlast.

"Supported" is my reading of AB-6.3-02, so it is an assumption. A read is supported when all of these hold:
- arburst is not 3.
- arsize is at most 2.
- arcache is 0000 or 0001.
- An INCR burst does not cross a 4-KiB boundary.
- A WRAP burst has arlen of 1, 3, 7 or 15.

The WRAP length rule is not stated in the check text. I added it from the AXI specification.

The tracker stores each APB read completion (prdata and pslverr) in a 256-entry array. It treats a completion on the same edge as an R beat as available to that beat. APB completions are counted only while rd_busy is set, the read is supported, and pwrite is 0.

The tracker only starts a new transaction when it is idle. An AR accepted on the same edge as the final R handshake would be missed.
